row.team_price_text: Dayforce Platform: $171.96 per employee per year (MSRP price book)
row.evidence: Dayforce's published MSRP price book lists the Dayforce Platform at $171.96 per employee per year, and its identity integrations (Aquera Identity Integration, Okta's Dayforce HR-as-a-Master connector) synchronize user information from Dayforce outward; the public help portal returns no SCIM results.
row.notes: New row. Ceridian rebranded as Dayforce. Dayforce is an HR system of record: user accounts normally come from the New Hire form in People, and every identity integration found pushes data out of Dayforce (Aquera Identity Integration, Okta 'Dayforce by Aquera' HR-as-a-Master), so under rule 3a status is none (by absence; the public help portal search for SCIM returns 0 results). SSO is SAML: Entra gallery app (SP-initiated, users must already exist) and Okta 'Dayforce HCM SAML' app; Okta's older 'Ceridian Dayforce HCM' app is SWA. Pricing comes from Dayforce's published MSRP price book (8/31/2026; the SLP list, likely public-sector): Platform $171.96 per employee per year = $14.33/employee/mo; Payroll, Time, Talent etc. are add-on packages. No SSO or SCIM SKU is listed. Dayforce Web Services (REST) can create, read and update employees via /api/{CompanyName}/V1/Employees; its packaging/plan is not stated.

plans.name: Dayforce Platform
plans.notes: Core package; Payroll ($90.72), Time and Attendance ($54.84), Benefits, Talent and other packages are priced per employee per year on top. Prices from the SLP MSRP price book.

scim.notes: No inbound SCIM endpoint documented (rule 3a). Dayforce help portal (help.dayforce.com) search for 'SCIM' returns 0 results; identity integrations treat Dayforce as the source.

auth.notes: Web Services user credentials, or an access token from the Dayforce identity service obtained with those credentials.

endpoints.purpose: List employee XRefCodes (filterable by query parameters)

user_api.notes: Dayforce Web Services manage employee (HR) records; Dayforce user accounts for employees come from employee records. A SOAP API also exists. Which package includes Web Services is not stated.

okta.notes: Three OIN apps: 'Dayforce HCM SAML' (SAML), 'Ceridian Dayforce HCM' (SWA) and 'Dayforce by Aquera' (HR-as-a-Master, imports from Dayforce into Okta; third-party, not provisioning into Dayforce).

entra.notes: Gallery app 'Ceridian Dayforce HCM'; tutorial covers SAML SSO only and says users are created with Dayforce support before SSO.

fallbacks.other_sync: Outbound only: Aquera Identity Integration and Okta 'Dayforce by Aquera' HR-as-a-Master sync worker data from Dayforce to IdPs/directories
fallbacks.notes: jit false comes from Microsoft's tutorial ('Users must be created and activated before you use single sign-on'). SSO logins are set per user in People > Security Settings > Single Sign On Logins.
